top_creatures.label: Ember-winged skyrider
top_creatures.why: A flying body that reads as one family in several element colours; flying plus melee, ranged and cast gives several attack shapes from one template.
top_creatures.keep: One base body with element passes; flying with a threat radius of 8; a shared hit sound.
top_creatures.change: Our own body plan (not a winged lizard); armour plates in place of wings; our own palette.

top_creatures.label: Ward-bearer beast
top_creatures.why: A two-second window where it reflects projectiles, then a ring burst. Players can learn the tell.
top_creatures.keep: Buff then burst; 100 percent reflect for 2 seconds; return damage for 2 seconds.
top_creatures.change: Our own shield visual (not an orange ring); a half-second wind-up tell; a ring that does not push.

top_creatures.label: Radial turret
top_creatures.why: A ring of twelve missiles is a clear shape at 375 wide; the ice volley slows the target.
top_creatures.keep: Radial volley; slow on hit (50 percent for 2 seconds on the ice variant).
top_creatures.change: Eight shots with one rotating gap, so the player can step through.

top_creatures.label: Three-aspect warden
top_creatures.why: Cycles elemental three-missile volleys and is immune to bleed and to slow or stun, which forces ability variety.
top_creatures.keep: Element cycle of three-missile volleys; passive status immunities.
top_creatures.change: Our own three aspects; immunity to one status family only; a visible telegraph before each volley.

top_creatures.label: Brood-mound
top_creatures.why: The parent births small children through spawn powers, with fire and ice versions; good for a swarm the player must thin out.
top_creatures.keep: Spawn-on-threshold with small children (20-60 HP); two spawn power steps.
top_creatures.change: Our own brood sprites; a cap on live children (Frankendom MAX_ATTACKERS is 3); a spawn cooldown.

top_creatures.label: Leech walker
top_creatures.why: A basic melee strike that heals the attacker makes a slow zombie a clear threat with a clear response.
top_creatures.keep: Hit-point steal on a basic melee strike (hp_steal=50 on the strike power).
top_creatures.change: A heal cap per fight; a visible drain link between the two actors.

top_creatures.label: Alarm-caller goblin
top_creatures.why: First contact pulls the pack in; the engine emits the beacon on join-combat, so the pull is a data power.
top_creatures.keep: Join-combat emits a radius-4 pull power.
top_creatures.change: Pull only the two nearest; show a horn ring; add a cooldown.
top_creatures.ref: mods/fantasycore/enemies/base/beacon.txt line 2 (id 132, see correction); mods/empyrean_campaign/enemies/base/beacon.txt line 2 (id 161); mods/empyrean_campaign/powers/categories/beacon.txt lines 4 and 12

top_creatures.label: Pocket thief
top_creatures.why: A timed theft is a distinct threat that is not damage; the steal is a melee hit with a 20-second cooldown plus an on-hit script.
top_creatures.keep: 20-second cooldown melee hit; on-hit script hook.
top_creatures.change: Steal a consumable, not gear; return it on kill.

looks.label: Element variants on one body
looks.technique: Swap the animation sheet per element on the same base body (fire, water and air animation files; ice template points at a water animation).

looks.label: Idle loop
looks.technique: Eight-frame stance at 800 ms, looped, as the idle when nothing happens.

looks.label: Ring shield
looks.technique: Orange shield sprite on a radius-2 hazard that lasts two seconds.

looks.label: Sparkle sprite
looks.technique: Looped 20-frame sparkle at 1 second; use sites not checked.

looks.label: Loot drop sheet
looks.technique: Six-frame sheet played once over 600 ms, one sheet per gear base (39 loot animation files).

looks.label: Quality badge
looks.technique: A colour and an overlay icon per quality, with a fixed sort order.

looks.label: Status effect animations
looks.technique: 38 effect blocks; bleeding uses a red spark loop, mage shield uses a shield animation.

looks.label: Split death sounds
looks.technique: Normal death and critical death have separate sound cues.

originals.name: Ember-winged skyrider
originals.idea: A flying elemental beast built on one base body with element passes.
originals.keep: One body with element passes; flying with a close threat radius.
originals.change: Body plan, wing shape and palette.

originals.name: Ward-bearer
originals.idea: A buff-then-burst beast with a readable tell.
originals.keep: A two-second reflect window then a ring burst.
originals.change: A half-second wind-up tell; a ring that does not push.

originals.name: Radial turret
originals.idea: A stationary turret that fires a ring volley.
originals.keep: Radial volley with a slow on hit.
originals.change: Eight shots with a rotating gap.

originals.name: Three-aspect warden
originals.idea: A boss that cycles elemental volleys and resists some status effects.
originals.keep: The element cycle and the status immunities.
originals.change: Our own aspects; immunity to one status family; a telegraph before each volley.

originals.name: Brood-mound
originals.idea: A spawner that births small children when it is hurt.
originals.keep: Spawn at a threshold; small children.
originals.change: A cap of 3 live children; our own sprites; a cooldown.

originals.name: Leech walker
originals.idea: A slow zombie whose basic strike heals it.
originals.keep: Hit-point steal on a basic strike.
originals.change: A heal cap and a visible drain link.

originals.name: Alarm-caller
originals.idea: First contact pulls nearby enemies in as a data-driven power.
originals.keep: A join-combat pull implemented as a power.
originals.change: Only the two nearest; a horn ring; a cooldown.

originals.name: Pocket thief

originals.keep: A 20-second cooldown and the script hook.
originals.change: Steal a consumable and return it on kill.

originals.idea: A generated maze stitched from room chunks with a main path, branches and keyed doors.
